en: A black and white image depicting a densely packed historic European cityscape with rows of old buildings featuring steep gabled roofs. There are several church towers visible, including a prominent steeple near the center and another large church with twin towers and a simple, rectangular front on the right. In the foreground, a row of elegant 19th-century townhouses lines a tree-filled avenue.
